parameters.description: Column and value pairs every row must match, e.g. {"status": "active"}. A list matches any of its values; null matches a missing value (NULL), not empty text. To compare, give an operator: {"amount": {">=": 10}}, {"name": {"contains": "ada"}} or {"created_at": {"between": ["2026-01-01", "2026-02-01"]}}. Operators: =, !=, >, >=, <, <=, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, like, not_like, in, not_in, between, is_null. contains, starts_with and ends_with take the text as written and ignore case; like and not_like take a pattern, with % for any text and _ for one character.

postgres_new_or_updated_row_trigger.description: Runs when a row is added to or changed in a PostgreSQL table, found by checking a column the table sets to the current time on every change, such as updated_at. Rows as they were before the workflow was turned on don't trigger it.

parameters.name: table

parameters.name: column

parameters.description: The table's schema. Leave blank for the default (public).
parameters.name: schema

postgres_new_row_trigger.description: Runs when a row is added to a PostgreSQL table, found by checking for rows past the highest id (or other ever-growing column) seen so far. Rows already in the table don't trigger it.

parameters.name: table
